beats.text: Sierra Leone has a gross enrollment ratio of 162%. The USA has 97%.
In Sierra Leone, this ratio counts total enrollment, regardless of age, against the official school-age population.
Sierra Leone is the world's highest with a gross enrollment ratio of 162%.
Somalia is the world's lowest at 21%.
India has a gross enrollment ratio of 111%. The USA has 97%.
Rwanda has a gross enrollment ratio of 150%, Malawi has 139%, and Madagascar has 133%.
